śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ
śrī mahādeva uvācaḥ
tatas rāmaḥ svayam prāha hanumantam upasthitam
śrṛṇu pravakṣyāmi hi ātma anātma parātmanām
ākāśasya yathā bhedaḥ trividhaḥ dṛśyate mahān
jalāśaye mahā ākāśaḥ tad avacchinnaḥ eva hi
pratibimba ākhyam aparam dṛśyate trividham nabhaḥ
buddhi avacchinna caitanyam ekam pūrṇam atha aparam
ābhāsaḥ tu aparam bimba bhūtam evam tridhā citiḥ
sa ābhāsa buddheḥ kartṛ tvam avicchinne vikāriṇi
sākṣiṇi āropyate bhrāntyā jīva tvam ca tathā abudhaiḥ
ābhāsaḥ tu mṛṣābuddhiḥ avidyā kāryam ucyate
avicchinnam tu tat brahma vicchedaḥ tu vikalpitaḥ
avicchinnasya pūrṇena eka tvam pratipadyate
tatvamasi ādi vākyaiḥ ca sa ābhāsasya ahamaḥ tathā
aikya jñānam yadā utpannam mahā vākyena ca ātmanoḥ
tadā avidyā sva kāryaiḥ ca naśyati eva na saṃśayaḥ 7
